title: A sunscreen model has spectral bands, not one universal shield factor
original_forecast: Review band-specific incident and transmitted-state information rather than assigning the UVB protection factor to every wavelength. The water-only vessel is a formulation-omission control.
original_limitations: This is a standard-film teaching model: it does not predict applied thickness, skin exposure, safety, photostability, or the protection of any real commercial product.

question.original_criterion: Does the same declared formulation attenuate UVA, UVB and visible input according to different model bands?
question.original_instruction: Review band-specific incident and transmitted-state information rather than assigning the UVB protection factor to every wavelength. The water-only vessel is a formulation-omission control.
question.assessment: Equal incident irradiance receives distinct supportedUVB/UVA declared standard-film attenuation factors. No visible550nm attenuation or waterUV absorption is inferred from absent events. Original model-domain question is answered within280–400nm only; no measured continuous spectrum, thickness, photostability, exposure or safety claim.
